title: Enumeration of Finite Oracle Machines
statement: There is a sequence $(N_i)_{i\in\mathbb N}$ of finite oracle Turing machines over the binary alphabet such that, for every finite binary oracle machine $M$ and every natural number $i_0$, there is an index $i\ge i_0$ for which $N_i$ and $M$ compute exactly the same outputs within exactly $t$ steps, for every binary oracle language, binary input and output strings, and natural number $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite oracle Turing machine over the binary alphabet
The comparison ranges over every binary oracle language
The comparison ranges over all binary input and output strings
The comparison ranges over every natural number time bound $t$
